ref: ADR-0006 "Target fields": the queue of each mapped target field is evaluated lazily on first read, so a field never created is never evaluated
note: Item per Memo/Text in context Orders: the Order has no Memo, so Item has no occurrence and V under it is never created. V's queue, sortByKey over two Skus and one Qty in the Order, would raise po:SORTBYKEY at K1 if it were evaluated; read on first use only, it never is, and the run writes Out without an Item.
